title: Redact Secret adapter release feed, v1
description: What redact-secret-adapters declares it ships, per package: registry name, version, channel, and the core, host and runtime ranges CI qualifies, with the endpoints it tests. Generated by scripts/generate-site-feed.mjs from the release plan, the package manifests and compatibility.json; never edited by hand. A breaking change to this shape ships as site-feed/v2/ with a new schemaVersion, and v1 keeps its meaning. See RELEASING.md § The site release feed.

schemaVersion.description: A consumer that does not recognise this value must refuse the feed.

generatedAt.description: Derived from the inputs, never from a wall clock: compatibility.json's endpointsResolvedAt, at midnight UTC. The same inputs always produce the same value. The revision is the commit the consumer fetched the feed at.

sources.description: Repository-relative paths of the files the feed was generated from, at the same commit.

packages.description: Every package the release process publishes, in release-plan order. A package that is not released (private, unwired) is absent.

tested.description: The two versions of a range CI installs and runs the real-host tests against. A version between them is inside the range but is not itself tested.

range.description: The range exactly as the package manifest declares it.

extra.description: The Python extra that pulls this requirement in, when there is one.

id.description: Stable identifier: the package's git-tag prefix (RELEASING.md § Trains).

name.description: The name on the ecosystem's registry.

version.description: The version the manifest declares. On main and release it is published (reconcile verifies it); on develop it may be bumped ahead of the next train.

channel.description: npm: the dist-tag it publishes under. PyPI: latest for a final release, alpha, beta or rc for a pre-release, dev for a development release.

prerelease.description: True exactly when channel is not latest.

tested.description: The runtime versions CI runs the suite on.

core.description: The Redact Secret core this package runs over (@redact-secret/core on npm, redact-secret on PyPI).

hosts.description: Every other declared range CI qualifies: host SDKs and optional extras, sorted by name.

dependsOn.description: Runtime dependencies on other packages in this feed, with the declared range, sorted by name.
